what: On hover, a pale 1px border button draws dark lines one at a time, each in .04s at .08s intervals: top edge (left→right), right edge (top→bottom), bottom edge (right→left), left edge (bottom→top). The background fills with the line color in .4s and the text turns white. On release they retract in the same order

options.--fx-side: Length of time to draw one side (set via style), default .04s
options.--fx-gap: Gap between edges (set via style), default .08s
options.--fx-fill-dur: Background and text color duration (via style), default .4s
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Inner text — draws the bottom and left edges (must be present for all four edges to be drawn)

note: CSS only — not painted on devices without a hand (hover: none). The original turned it off the same way at 880px and below
